spec_match.rationale: Scripted narrative only; the code sample uses navigator.modelContext.tools and navigator.modelContext.callTool(), neither of which exists — the spec has document.modelContext.getTools() and executeTool(tool, input).

interactive.rationale: Three scenario buttons, Step and Reset all work (8/9/6 steps, message log and annotation update, Reset returns to Step 0) but the content is fixed text, with no real call.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Index promises a step-through annotated simulation and the page delivers exactly that.

edge_cases.rationale: Includes an 'unknown tool' capability-gap scenario, but no rejected/throwing execute, schema-mismatch input, toolcancel, or user-consent denial branches.

references.rationale: Cites chromestatus.com/feature/5117755740913664 and modelcontextprotocol.io; no WebMCP spec/explainer link.

conformance.rationale: Feature suite (6 assertions) reports 6/6 PASS on CfT 153 both with and without --enable-experimental-web-platform-features; without the flag every assertion passes vacuously (guards like !('modelContext' in document)||…), and registertool-rejects-tool-without-name passes only because reading registerTool off undefined throws TypeError — a false pass that needs a human to review (suite is immutable). The suite targets document.modelContext while this page probes navigator.modelContext.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 driven by Node Playwright (chromium.launch) against a local server on :3111 — NOT chrome-devtools-mcp, which is unavailable in this environment, so this is not DevTools-MCP-verified evidence; no accessibility-tree dump was taken. Every scenario stepped to completion and reset; zero console errors or failed requests. At 360×740 DPR3 the 3-track grid (1fr 60px 1fr) forces 238px horizontal overflow (layout viewport widened to 598px, arena column right edge 443px). UPDATE 2026-11-08: Fix verified on headless Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12 via Node Playwright (not chrome-devtools-mcp) on local :3112, 360x740 DPR3 touch + 1280x800; screenshots in /tmp/claude-0/shots/webmcp-fix/. All scenarios stepped to completion (8/9/6) and Reset works by real pointer click on mobile (previously intercepted because of the overflow); zero console errors; 0px overflow both classes.

telemetry_health.rationale: Only shared runtime/console error capture; no step/interaction or assertion events.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables, readable contrast in screenshots, scenario buttons pair bg/color.

accessibility.rationale: Native buttons with visible text; #annotation is now aria-live=polite and the message log role=log (2026-11-08), so Step progress is announced. The active scenario still has no aria-pressed.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Fixed 2026-11-08: 0px horizontal overflow at 360×740 DPR3 and 1280×800 at load and through every step of all three scenarios (previously 238px at load, up to 1003px mobile / 343px desktop mid-scenario because long JSON widened the 1fr tracks). Remaining: 4 of 5 controls are <44px tall on mobile.

openQuestions.title: Probe the real document.modelContext surface instead of navigator.modelContext and drop origin-trial framing
openQuestions.detail: The current WebMCP spec puts the entry point on Document ([SecureContext, SameObject] readonly attribute ModelContext modelContext) with registerTool(tool, {exposedTo, signal}) → Promise, getTools(), executeTool(tool, inputString) and ontoolchange/ontoolactivated/ontoolcancel; tool callbacks are `execute`, not `handler`/`invoke`. On CfT 153 with --enable-experimental-web-platform-features (also --enable-blink-features=WebMCP or --enable-features=WebMCP) document.modelContext exists and navigator.modelContext does not, so the page's probe/copy is wrong even when the API is live. ChromeStatus lists status 'Proposed', origintrial:false, flag 'Experimental Web Platform features' — replace the 'Origin Trial simulation' banner with the exact chrome://flags/#enable-experimental-web-platform-features steps.

openQuestions.title: Expose the selected scenario and enlarge touch targets
openQuestions.detail: #annotation (aria-live=polite) and #message-log (role=log) were made live regions 2026-11-08. Still open: set aria-pressed on the active scenario button; 4 of 5 controls are <44px tall on mobile.

openQuestions.title: Replace the fictional callTool() sequence with the real getTools()/executeTool() round trip
openQuestions.detail: When document.modelContext exists (flag), register the scenario's tools, list them with getTools() and run executeTool(tool, JSON-string input) so the 'tool manifest' and 'handler result' messages are real; keep the scripted path as a labelled fallback.

openQuestions.title: Add consent / cancellation / execute-rejection scenarios
openQuestions.detail: Spec defines toolactivated/toolcancel events and execute promise rejection; a scenario set that shows a tool erroring and a user cancelling covers the failure-mode angle.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use intrinsic/grid layouts that collapse to one column at narrow widths (minmax(0,1fr), container/media queries) so no fixed-column track forces horizontal overflow.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Followed (fixed 2026-11-08) — tracks are minmax(0,1fr) and the arena stacks to one column at ≤640px; 0px overflow at 360px.

guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce asynchronous/changing results through a polite live region (role=status/log or aria-live) and keep controls as native buttons with accessible names.
Selection groups should be native <button>s exposing state (aria-pressed / radio semantics) so keyboard Enter/Space activates and the selected option is announced.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Not followed — scenario buttons have no aria-pressed state.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive grid stacks on narrow screens without horizontal overflow
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use minmax(0,1fr) grid tracks and collapse to one column at narrow widths so intrinsic content cannot force horizontal overflow (also consulted responsive-design).
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Applied — grid-template-columns: minmax(0,1fr) 60px minmax(0,1fr), a ≤640px media query stacks agent/divider/page, and message <pre> wraps (pre-wrap, overflow-wrap:anywhere). Before: 238px overflow at load and up to 1003px (mobile) / 343px (desktop) while stepping; after: 0px throughout.

summary: A clear, well-written scripted walkthrough, honestly labelled a simulation, but its protocol code names APIs (navigator.modelContext.tools/callTool) that do not exist, and its arena overflows by 238px on mobile. 2026-11-08 fix: the arena now stacks on narrow screens with 0px overflow and the log/annotation are live regions; the navigator.modelContext API naming remains open.
